```python
import os, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, pathlib, time
profile = pathlib.Path.home()/".config/libreoffice/4/user"
profile.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cfg = profile/"registrymodifications.xcu"
NS = "http://openoffice.org/2001/registry"
ET.register_namespace("oor", NS)
if cfg.exists() and cfg.stat().st_size > 0:
    tree = ET.parse(cfg)
    root = tree.getroot()
else:
    root = ET.Element(f"{{{NS}}}items")
    tree = ET.ElementTree(root)
target_path = "/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Undo"
target_name = "Steps"
found = None
for item in root.findall(f"{{{NS}}}item"):
    if item.get(f"{{{NS}}}path") == target_path and item.get(f"{{{NS}}}name") == target_name:
        found = item
        break
if found is None:
    found = ET.SubElement(root, f"{{{NS}}}item", {f"{{{NS}}}path": target_path, f"{{{NS}}}name": target_name, f"{{{NS}}}op": "fuse"})
val = found.find("value")
if val is None:
    val = ET.SubElement(found, "value")
val.text = "100"
tree.write(cfg, encoding="UTF-8", xml_declaration=True)
time.sleep(0.5)
```
